"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party will continue to support the spread of democracy across Africa, Asia, and the Middle East.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party will continue to support the development of judiciary, legal systems, media and civil society organizations.",
